answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 168181 Country: KSA Title: Is it valid to stitch below ihram cloth from one side just like closed lungi? Question: Is it valid to stitch below ihram cloth from one side just like closed lungi? Answer ID: 168181 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 861/521/H=05/1440) It is lawful to stitch the cloth of ihram from one side i.e. its one corner. There is no harm in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
